subject: CloudPro renewal — payor/entity migration and evidence for split invoicing
messages:
From: Marta Gomez <marta@cloudpro.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity add — billing split request and PO attached

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the renewal quote — CloudPro will proceed with the 2x capacity add (Q3 start). Finance has one operational request: we need invoices split between two legal entities going forward. Our US parent will cover 60% of the committed capacity and our EU subsidiary (CloudPro EU Ltd.) will cover 40%. We have an active PO for the parent but need to add the EU entity for the remainder.

Action items from our side (attached):
- Attached: purchase_order_2219.pdf (PO for US portion)
- Please confirm the fields you need for CloudPro EU Ltd. (VAT ID, registered address, contact) and whether we need a separate PO for EU billing
- Let us know if net terms will be the same (we typically run Net30 for US; EU entities normally prefer Net60)

Can you loop in billing so we can get a mutual action plan? We’d like invoices to align with our accounting cutoffs.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Marta
Head of Procurement, CloudPro
Marta Gomez | marta@cloudpro.com

---
Attachment: purchase_order_2219.pdf (application/pdf, 54KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta@cloudpro.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — billing split request and PO attached

Hi Marta — thanks for the PO and the heads-up. Looping Ben (billing ops) and Marissa (CS) so we can align on routing and invoicing cadence.

Quick plan to accelerate this:
1) Please confirm the CloudPro EU legal name exactly as you want it to appear on invoices, EU VAT ID, and registered address. If you have a PO number for the EU entity, include that — otherwise we can accept a single change request and map the quantity split on our side.
2) Tell us which net terms you want for each entity (US Net30 or Net60; EU Net60 recommended). We can apply Net30 to the US PO and Net60 to the EU mapping if that’s the ask.
3) Provide the billing contact for CloudPro EU (name + email) and whether AP will route payments centrally or per-entity.

Ben — can you confirm what documents we need to accept the EU entity (W-8/W-9 not applicable for EU; we typically require VAT registration docs or a signed EU vendor form). If we need a DocuSign amendment to the PO, I’ll ask the customer to sign.

Marissa — flagging the capacity add for July 1 start; please add CloudPro EU mapping to the rollout notes so usage is charged to the correct entity.

Happy to set up a 20-minute call if that gets this over the line faster.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Evelyn Hart | evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

Cc: Thomas Nguyen <thomas@cloudpro.com>
Date: 2028-06-03T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + capacity add — billing split request and PO attached

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the quick reply. Per procurement, here are the details for the EU entity:

CloudPro EU Ltd.
VAT ID: GB999888777
Registered address: 14 Albion Square, London, UK, SW1A 1AA
Billing contact: Thomas Nguyen <thomas@cloudpro.com>, +44 20 7946 0123
Preferred net terms: EU entity requests Net60; US parent will keep Net30

We do not have a separate PO for the EU entity yet — we will sign an amendment to the existing PO to outline the 60/40 split and assign an internal cost center for CloudPro EU. I’ve initiated a DocuSign packet for the PO amendment (link below). Once signed, our AP team will forward the amended PO and a mapping sheet to help reconcile invoices.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/packet/abc123

CloudPro Finance (AP)
ap@cloudpro.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudPro Finance <ap@cloudpro.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — billing split request and PO attached

Thanks team — I’ve processed the routing request in our billing system. Notes:
- Two invoice routes created: CloudPro US (EIN on file) and CloudPro EU Ltd. (VAT ID GB999888777)
- We will apply Net30 to the US invoices and Net60 to the EU invoices as requested
- For bookkeeping we map line items 1–6 to the US PO and line items 7–10 to the EU entity per the amendment.

CloudPro AP — could you please upload the mapping CSV with cost-center codes and the final signed amendment when DocuSign completes? That helps us generate combined delivery reports and ensures the correct GL codes on the invoice. I’ve attached a sample entity_mapping_sheet.csv template to show the fields we need.

Once we have the signed amendment and mapping, invoices for June consumption will be split in the July invoice run. If you prefer, we can also issue two separate invoices in July (one per entity) — confirm which you prefer and we’ll update the delivery method.

Thanks — looping Marissa so CS can confirm the July rollout mapping.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
